comment: Reusable injection patterns that embed the NMBL grammar inside `<template lang="nmbl"> ... </template>` blocks of a code sample. astro.config registers this once per host grammar — Vue (`text.html.vue`), Svelte (`source.svelte`), and Astro (`source.astro`) — each with its own scopeName + `injectTo` + `L:` injectionSelector, so the template body is highlighted as `source.nmbl` instead of the host's default markup. Other `<template>` blocks (no `lang`, or a different `lang`) are untouched. NOTE: must be registered as three SEPARATE single-scope injections, not one multi-scope injection — a combined selector breaks Vue's special `<template>` handling.
